_readme: ADA's corrections to KITOB's English hotel descriptions (hotelsofnorthcyprus.com), applied by scripts/import-hnc-hotels.mjs BEFORE the translation sha is computed. Keyed by KITOB hotel name. source_sha = sha256(KITOB's English).slice(0,16) the correction was written against: if KITOB changes that text the importer refuses until the correction is re-reviewed. Not scripts/convert-kitob-xlsx.py's overrides.json (that one corrects the KITOB list).

Lord's Palace Hotel & Spa.en: In our hotel, there are 250 rooms with mountain, city and sea view. Rooms are categorized as standard, suite, connection suite and Lord & Lordess Suite. Our rooms have been designed for your comfort; some of the services available in our rooms include A/C, shower, hair dryer, telephone, television, safe, Wi-Fi, etc. You can enjoy tea & coffee set-up and 2 bottles of water daily as complimentary. With PAY TV service, you can enjoy the latest movies, sports or kids movies, also you can choose to not to be disturbed while watching and resting in your room by activating the DND button at your bedside. You can get your room cleaned firstly by activating the ‘Clean My Room’ button. For any information about PAY TV please dial “OSS”. Your room is made ready for your sleep each evening with Turn Down Service.

Merit Park Hotel.en: Beachfront, 6 km to city centre, 55 km to closest Airport. Indoor-outdoor swimming pool, A la Carte Restaurant, 5 different bars, indoor-outdoor restaurant, kiddy pool, mini club for kids, rent a car service, shopping mall, hairdresser, doctor service, business center, internet cafe and parking. Total 296 rooms and 2 types of rooms, including standard rooms and family rooms. Rooms offer Led TV, Satellite, Telephone, minibar, central heating system, hair dryer, bathtub and balcony. Floors all covered with carpet. Turkish Bath, Sauna, fitness center, wi-fi acces. All Inclusive Consept: The Current Concept Hours: Breakfast, lunch and dinner buffet meals and local alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks. Services other than those specified in will be charged extra.

The Colony Hotel.en: Located in the heart of downtown Kyrenia the five star The Colony Hotel lies between the mountains of North Cyprus and the timeless blue Mediterranean Sea. Architecturally blending the colonial style of the island's past with the glory of the Ottoman era, The Colony is a haven of tranquility and opulence amidst the bustle of this busy town and harbor. With a total of 94 rooms and suites The Colony is justly proud of its reputation for stylish elegance and comfort in its surroundings. All Colony guest rooms and suites have been designed and furnished to the highest international hotel standards. Our Heritage Lounge is the place to meet during the day or to gather for pre-dinner drinks. A great place to enjoy the buzz of Cypriot life or to go over the days events with friends or family. Our waiters are here to serve you snacks or afternoon tea during the day or bar service at any time. In the short winter shake off the chill of the evening around the log fire. Dining choices include the Premier Restaurant for a full a la carte menu or the Courtyard Piazza for a less formal meal. In the summer lunch and dinner are served al fresco at the panoramic rooftop Vista Terrace and Misty Bar. Dining here as the sun goes down over distant mountains and the sea changes to an ever deeper purple will remain in your memory long after you leave this beautiful island. The Colony Spa and Wellness Centre aims to provide everything our guests may demand for exercise, relaxation and rejuvenation. The exercise room includes a full range of machines and weights to meet a training regime or just to tone up the muscles. Our personal trainers are on hand to advise on the most effective program to meet each individual's needs. Treatment facilities include a reflexology lounge, Jacuzzi, solarium, steam room and sauna. Our masseurs offer Swedish, sports, deep tissue and orthopedic massages. Elegantly appointed and arranged over two floors joined by a sweeping marble staircase the Colony Casino would not be out of place in London, Cannes or Monte Carlo.

Arkın Palm Beach Hotel.en: The Arkin Palm Beach Hotel is located in the ancient port city of Famagusta, North Cyprus. The Hotel offers "a Heaven on Earth Location" where the turquoise hues of the Mediterranean Sea meet the magnificence of its private golden beach. The hotel has a total of 102 guest rooms, including 76 standard rooms,3 family rooms and 23 suites. Room facilities are impressive, and include air-conditioning, safety-deposit box, complimentary high speed Internet connection, interactive satellite TV, hairdryer, bathrobe and slippers. Recreational facilities include a stunning indoor and outdoor swimming pool, private sandy beach, sauna and steam room, gym and massage and therapy services (extra). In addition to this, the dining and beverage options are fantastic with the Cascata restaurant that serves Turkish and International cuisine, and the Pier Restaurant (seasonal) which serves the local dishes of North Cyprus. There are three main bars in the hotel where you can have masterfully prepared cocktails and light snacks.

Grand Pasha Nicosia Hotel Casino Spa.en: At the most distinguished street, Dereboyu, which is the heart of Nicosia; just at walking distance to business, finance, art, culture, entertainment, governmental offices and 25 km from the airport; just in the middle of the life. The hotel offers 139 rooms; 112 standart, 11 corner rooms, 15 suites and a king suite room. Hotel features 1300m2 pool side; the biggest swimming pool 250 m2 and the largest event area in Nicosia. It has 3 meeting halls and recent techological meeting equipments. The main restaurant of the hotel; Grenada A’la Carte Restaurant meets you the unique world and Mediterranean cuisine. Its casino; Pasha Casino is the finest casino in Northern Cyprus where quality and service can be experienced with high limited gaming tables and the newest slot machines. Other hotel facilities are Tulipano Lounge, Lobby Bar, SPA & Welness Center, massage rooms, Turkish bath, sauna, coiffeur, boutique and jewelery store.

Liman Casino Hotel.en: Modern and stylish architecture, with high standards of design and enjoyable to spend time with the rest of our guests in our rooms every detail has been designed at the level of elite tastes. Our total number of rooms is 31. Liman Hotel has all conditions for good rest and recuperates after a busy day. We guarantee full privacy, comfort, tranquility, professionalism and high quality service to our guests. According to our rooms with amazing sea and pool view.

Sunport Hotel.en: Sunport Hotel ,is situated on the wonderful white beach of Girne, and offers the perfect setting for rare moments of romance , adventure and excitement, and memories to last a lifetime. The Hotel is only 4 kilometers from Girne. We have 5 suıtes,6 deluxe and 73 standard rooms. They all come en-suite, bath or shower, central heating and cooling air-conditioning, satellite TV , telephones mini-bars and safety deposit boxes. All Rooms have either balconies or French balconies facing the beach and pool , offering stunning view’s over the Mediterranean, for those who want to asleep by listening wave’s sound. Sunport Hotel has two sandy beaches and an Anchor harbor providing opportunities for walking, sunbathing, swimming freely. The variety of water sports available. We have children’s pool and outdoor playground by the beach for small children and some activities to enjoy themselves. Sunport offers from fine dining and romance to casual outdoor meals overlooking the Mediterranean choosing from a menu of French, Turkish and International dishes. Our spacious terraces and outdoor bars are the ideal venue to enjoy enticing cocktails and spirits, as the waves crash against the rocks below. You may enjoy the best sunset in Cyprus with a special Ada Cocktails. The latest addition to our range of facilities is Wellness &SPA center. This includes Turkish Bath, Sauna, classical massages, medical massages ,Indian and Fareast massages and indoor pool. Sunport is a dream becoming reality.

Merit Royal Diamond Hotel.en: Get the celebrity treatment with world-class service at Merit Royal Diamond Hotel & SPA Elegant Accommodation: Merit Royal Diamond Hotel & SPA in Kyrenia offers a 5-star experience with spa facilities, a wellness centre, sauna, fitness centre, and a seasonal outdoor swimming pool. Guests enjoy free WiFi, a bar, and a garden. Comfortable Amenities: Rooms feature private bathrooms, air-conditioning, balconies with sea views, and modern amenities such as minibars and flat-screen TVs. Additional facilities include a hot tub, hammam, and free on-site private parking. Prime Location: Located a 5-minute walk from Municipality of Alsancak Beach, the hotel is 35 km from Venice Column. Exceptional Service: Highly rated for its attentive staff, excellent restaurant, and immaculate room cleanliness. Guests appreciate the attentive service and excellent dining options.

Olivia Palm Hotel.en: Set in Kyrenia, less than 1 km from Bella Marin Beach, Olivia Palm Hotel offers accommodation with an outdoor swimming pool, free private parking, a shared lounge and a terrace. Featuring a restaurant, the 3-star hotel has air-conditioned rooms with free WiFi, each with a private bathroom. The accommodation provides room service, a concierge service and currency exchange for guests. At the hotel, the rooms come with a desk and a flat-screen TV. Olivia Palm Hotel features certain units with sea views, and each room includes a balcony. At the accommodation every room includes bed linen and towels. Speaking Arabic, German, English and Russian at the reception, staff will be happy to provide guests with practical information on the area. Venice Column is 26 km from Olivia Palm Hotel. The property offers a paid airport shuttle service.

Novel Centre Point Hotel.en: Comfortable Accommodation: Novel Centre Point Hotel in Gazimagusa offers family rooms with air-conditioning, private bathrooms, balconies, and free WiFi. Each room includes a work desk, TV, and minibar. Dining and Leisure: Guests can enjoy a sun terrace, garden, restaurant, bar, and coffee shop. The family-friendly restaurant serves halal British, Greek, Mediterranean, and Turkish cuisines. Additional facilities include a games room, live music, and outdoor seating area. Convenient Location: Located 2.7 km from Glapsides Beach, the hotel provides easy access to local attractions. Free on-site private parking is available. Guest Services: The hotel offers a 24-hour front desk, concierge service, and a tour desk. Additional services include a minimarket, bicycle parking, and live music.

Hotel Sun.en: Hotel Sun offers a perfect combination of quality, comfort, and location. A familiar environment with a wide variety of services designed for every traveler visiting the city. It has 200 fully equipped rooms to designed to offer the best comfort in Nicosia. We also try to offer a happy, friendly, and professional atmosphere where our guests feel free to relax, unwind or work. Our establishment is one of the urban hotels with the best value you can find in Lefkoşa, the capital of North Cyprus, 24 km away from the Ercan International Airport and only 2 minutes from the city centre where you will find a great variety of cafes, restaurants, and shops. Come to discover us!
